cause_1: Streamlit 1.40 AppTest retains three previous final-decision radios in the immediate post-rerun tree, giving nine rather than six widgets. The response was saved and trial 2 had started.
fix_1: Check the actual stored response and the specific next-trial widget keys rather than a global widget count. Verify separate recommendation/explanation responses, trial 2 initial ratings still unlocked and unselected, and no trial-2 final decision.
cause_2: Synthetic Information-Seeking test creates pilot context but reads workstation collection mode; final mode has no corresponding synthetic final context, so registration is not rendered.
fix_2: Disable local runtime configuration loading only within monkeypatched test scope, force pilot modes temporarily and keep test databases/context temporary. Production runtime behavior unchanged.
pending_human_review: Expected. All 40 variants need genuine independent reviews under the v8 review policy. This hotfix does not bypass that policy.

validation.original_two_failures_reproduced: Both reproduced under Streamlit 1.40 and final-mode environment.
